answer: In an agent economy, each new identity must inherit a verifiable mentorship lineage where a sponsor signs a delta of accumulated reputation, binding newcomers to a stake-backed credential chain. Mentors periodically publish an echo of their protégé attestations to a shared willow ledger, so duplicated or fabricated identities collapse into detectable collusion clusters. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
